# web-arena-indigo

> Unofficial async Rust client crate for the WebARENA Indigo VPS API (the VPS service of
> NTTPC Communications, Japan); a community project not affiliated with NTTPC. Crate
> name: `web-arena-indigo`, library name: `web_arena_indigo`. Covers all 51 endpoints of
> the official REST API: instances (VMs), SSH keys, API keys, firewalls, snapshots, and
> DNS.

Key facts for generating code with this crate:

- Entry point: `WebArenaIndigoApi::new(client_id, client_secret)`; call
  `api.update_access_token().await?` once before other calls, or inject an existing token
  with `.with_access_token(token)`. `.with_base_url(url)` overrides the endpoint
  (proxy / mock server).
- All methods are `async` (use tokio or any executor; HTTP via reqwest) and return
  `Result<T, WebArenaIndigoApiError>`. The error enum has `Connection(String)`,
  `Status(u16, String)` (non-2xx, raw body), and `JsonParse(String)` (raw body).
- API groups are reached through accessors on `WebArenaIndigoApi`: `api.instance()`,
  `api.ssh()`, `api.api_key()`, `api.firewall()`, `api.snapshot()`, `api.dns()`.
  Request/response types live in the module of the same name
  (e.g. `web_arena_indigo::dns::ARecordRequest`).
- `CreateInstanceRequest` is an enum: `Standard { ssh_key_id, region_id, os_id,
  instance_plan, instance_name }`, `Windows { win_password, .. }`,
  `Import { import_url, .. }`, `FromSnapshot { ssh_key_id, snapshot_id, .. }`.
- `InstanceStatus::Destroy` deletes the instance; other variants are Start / Stop /
  ForceStop / Reset.
- The API's `sucessCode` (sic) response field is exposed as `success_code`.
- The Indigo API gateway rate-limits at 2 requests/second (burst 1). The client
  automatically paces requests (600 ms interval) and retries twice on 429; override
  with `.with_request_interval(Duration)` (`Duration::ZERO` disables pacing). There
  is also an account-level quota (~10 requests/minute observed); for long call
  sequences use a larger interval such as `Duration::from_secs(7)`.
- After `create_instance` the new instance rejects operations for a short while
  ("Instance ID is invalid"); an assigned firewall template cannot be deleted while
  its instance is active (error code F60009).
- MSRV 1.86, edition 2024. License MIT.

## Minimal example

```rust
use web_arena_indigo::WebArenaIndigoApi;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut api = WebArenaIndigoApi::new("CLIENT_ID", "CLIENT_SECRET");
    api.update_access_token().await?;
    for vm in api.instance().instance_list().await? {
        println!("{} {} {:?}", vm.instance_name, vm.status, vm.ipaddress);
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

## Full API surface

### Instance (VM) — accessor `api.instance()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::instance`

- `instance_type_list() -> InstanceTypeListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/instancetypes`
- `region_list(instance_type_id: u32) -> RegionListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/getregion`
- `os_list(instance_type_id: u32) -> OsListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/oslist`
- `instance_specification(instance_type_id: u32) -> InstanceSpecificationResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/getinstancespec`
- `create_instance(request: CreateInstanceRequest) -> CreateInstanceResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/createinstance`
- `instance_list() -> Vec<Instance>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/getinstancelist`
- `update_instance_status(instance_id: u32, status: InstanceStatus) -> UpdateInstanceStatusResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/instance/statusupdate`

### SSH Key — accessor `api.ssh()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::ssh`

- `ssh_key_list() -> SshKeyListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey`
- `active_ssh_key_list() -> ActiveSshKeyListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey/active/status`
- `create_ssh_key(name: &str, public_key: &str) -> CreateSshKeyResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey`
- `retrieve_ssh_key(ssh_key_id: u32) -> RetrieveSshKeyResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey/{id}`
- `update_ssh_key(ssh_key_id: u32, request: UpdateSshKeyRequest) -> UpdateSshKeyResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey/{id}`
- `destroy_ssh_key(ssh_key_id: u32) -> DestroySshKeyResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/vm/sshkey/{id}`

### API Key — accessor `api.api_key()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::api_key`

- `create_api_key() -> CreateApiKeyResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/auth/create/apikey`
- `api_key_list() -> ApiKeyListResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/auth/apikey`
- `destroy_api_key(api_key_id: u32) -> DestroyApiKeyResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/auth/apikey/{id}`

### Firewall — accessor `api.firewall()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::firewall`

- `create_firewall(request: CreateFirewallRequest) -> FirewallTemplateResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/createfirewall`
- `firewall_list() -> Vec<Firewall>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/getfirewalllist`
- `retrieve_firewall(firewall_id: u32) -> Vec<FirewallTemplateRule>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/gettemplate/{id}`
- `update_firewall(request: UpdateFirewallRequest) -> FirewallTemplateResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/updatefirewall`
- `assign_firewall(firewall_id: u32, instance_id: u32) -> FirewallOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/assign`
- `destroy_firewall(firewall_id: u32) -> FirewallOperationResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/nw/deletefirewall/{id}`

### Snapshot — accessor `api.snapshot()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::snapshot`

- `take_snapshot(name: &str, instance_id: u32, slot_num: u32) -> SnapshotStatusResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/disk/takesnapshot`
- `snapshot_list(instance_id: u32) -> Vec<Snapshot>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/disk/snapshotlist/{instance_id}`
- `retake_snapshot(instance_id: u32, snapshot_id: u32) -> SnapshotStatusResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/disk/retakesnapshot`
- `restore_snapshot(instance_id: u32, snapshot_id: u32) -> SnapshotStatusResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/disk/restoresnapshot`
- `destroy_snapshot(snapshot_id: u32) -> SnapshotStatusResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/disk/deletesnapshot/{id}`

### DNS — accessor `api.dns()`, types in module `web_arena_indigo::dns`

- `register_domain(domain_name: &str) -> RegisterDomainResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/registerdomain`
- `domain_list() -> Vec<DnsDomain>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/getdomainlist`
- `retrieve_domain(domain_id: u32) -> DnsDomain` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/getdomainrecord/{id}`
- `cancel_domain(domain_id: u32) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/canceldomain/{id}`
- `create_domain_verification_token(zone_id: u32, verify_type: DnsVerifyType) -> String` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/domainverificationtoken`
- `cancel_domain_verification(domain_id: u32) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/canceldomainverification/{id}`
- `verify_domain(domain_id: u32) -> DomainVerificationResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/domainverification/{id}`
- `domain_records(domain_id: u32) -> DomainRecordsResponse` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/editdomain/{id}`
- `ttl_list() -> Vec<DnsTtl>` — `GET /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/getttl`
- `add_a_record(request: ARecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addARecord`
- `update_a_record(request: ARecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateARecord`
- `add_aaaa_record(request: AaaaRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addAAAARecord`
- `update_aaaa_record(request: AaaaRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateAAAARecord`
- `add_cname_record(request: CnameRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addCNAMERecord`
- `update_cname_record(request: CnameRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateCNAMERecord`
- `add_mx_record(request: MxRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addMXRecord`
- `update_mx_record(request: MxRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateMXRecord`
- `add_txt_record(request: TxtRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addTXTRecord`
- `update_txt_record(request: TxtRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateTXTRecord`
- `add_ns_record(request: NsRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addNSRecord`
- `update_ns_record(request: NsRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateNSRecord`
- `add_srv_record(request: SrvRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `POST /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/addSRVRecord`
- `update_srv_record(request: SrvRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `PUT /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/updateSRVRecord`
- `destroy_record(request: DeleteRecordRequest) -> DnsOperationResponse` — `DELETE /webarenaIndigo/v1/dns/deleteNSRecord`
